event_family.terminal.submit: submit session input; text required, optional attachment refs
event_family.terminal.cancel: request cancellation of the current turn
event_family.focus.activate: request focus for a typed interaction target
event_family.interaction.question: user answer to a pending question

rules: kind is a closed whitelist; unknown kind fails fast
every intent carries a non-empty sourceId
payload fields are validated per kind; malformed payload fails fast
the bus appends eventId and acceptedAt and never mutates the intent
only this owner emits TuiInputIn02AppEvent; app-shell resolves TuiInputIn03BusinessAction
no control metadata, health, sequence, retry or ack fields enter the event payload
